result.root_cause: Kapwing gates its editor on a user-agent sniff in its bundled browser-detection helper, which matches only Chrome/Chromium tokens. Firefox falls through to the unsupported branch, which renders the warning toast. The check is purely on navigator.userAgent; no feature detection is involved, so the warning appears regardless of Firefox's actual capabilities.
result.evidence: Loading the editor in Firefox logs no console errors, but evaluate_script on navigator.userAgent inside the page followed by inspecting the bundled detection helper shows a regex matching /Chrome|CriOS/ only. Spoofing the Chrome UA string suppresses the toast entirely. The same page in Chrome never renders the toast element. A reduced testcase reproducing the same regex against both UA strings shows the warning path taken in Firefox only.
